company.name: Vikasha Aero Tech
company.description:
Revolutionizing commercial facility maintenance through DGCA-licensed robotic and drone-based cleaning solutions, completely eliminating human rigging risk on high-rise glass facades. Our certified pilots and robotics engineers deliver audited, insured and fully documented service across four operational hubs.

Since 2019 we have maintained more than 150 commercial towers across the technology parks of Bengaluru, Hyderabad, Pune and Chennai, with a two-hour dispatch commitment from each hub.
